Waffles

Time: 15 min
Servings: waffles
Source: https://www.bbc.co.uk/food/recipes/waffles_82356
Tags: tested, sweet, dessert, main-course, simple, vegetarian

Ingredients

  • 450ml full-fat milk
  • 3 large free-range eggs, separated
  • 125ml vegetable oil, plus extra for oiling if required
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 225g plain flour
  • 5 g (2 tsp) baking powder
  • 38g (3 tbsp) caster sugar
  • ¼ tsp fine sea salt
  • maple syrup, berries, or other stuff to serve

Instructions

Heat the waffle iron according to instructions (some need to be lightly oiled before you start).
Put the egg whites into a clean bowl and whisk to stiff peaks. Mix the other wet ingredients in a jug. Sift the dry ingredients into a large bowl. Pour the jug of wet ingredients into the bowl of dry ones and whisk together, making sure there are no lumps.
Slowly fold the egg whites into the batter.
Cook in waffle iron according to instructions. Serve immediately.
